title: Next-session refusal
description: The body of a coded refusal of the control plane to the next-session request, next-session-request.schema.json: Forager's link refusal, https://qory.dev/contracts/forager/v1/link-refusal.schema.json, with from apiary. The gateway passes on the control plane's signed coded refusal with its status, error, names and message, and sets from to apiary. error is one of nine codes, and each code has one status. The checks of every signed request come first: 429 rate_limited, the rate limit of the gateway's access key for the run endpoint is reached; 400 bad_request, an instance id that is absent or outside its pattern; 400 unsupported_contract_version, a contract version other than 1. Then the checks of the run: 404 not_found, an unknown run, a run of another gateway, an Explore run, or a run that the control plane does not run as a shared run; 409 run_ended, with message, a run that ended, that a member cancelled, that the stage no longer runs, whose last step returned end, or whose next session has inputs that cannot be formed. Then the checks of the request: 413 payload_too_large, a body over 4 KiB, which reaches qory only when the control plane's limit is lower than the gateway's: the gateway's limit for this request is also 4 KiB, and for a longer body the gateway returns 413 payload_too_large with from gateway and does not forward it; 400 invalid_request, a body outside next-session-request.schema.json, or whose must_understand lists a pointer that the control plane does not define, with names, the first member that fails or body for a body that is not a JSON object, and message; 409 session_mismatch, with message, a session lower than the newest session that the run reported; 503 unavailable, the control plane could not complete the request and stored nothing, so the same request can be sent again. A signing header sent twice gets a 400 bad_request that is not signed: the gateway returns 502 control_plane_unavailable with from gateway for it, and this document does not describe it. names and message are optional here, as in the link refusal. A refusal of the gateway, with from gateway, is not this document. The other members are as the link refusal defines them.

error.description: The code of the control plane's refusal: bad_request, invalid_request, not_found, payload_too_large, rate_limited, run_ended, session_mismatch, unavailable or unsupported_contract_version.

from.description: apiary: the gateway passes on the control plane's refusal.
